# Location scope: marks here (goods and buildings).
pp_lplan_planned_n = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
		value = var:pp_lplan_n
		subtract = 100
	}
}
# Location scope: goods marked here (the Location Plan window's count; the marked buildings are not in it).
